headline: Older browsers can now get past the startup screen of the public demo
summary: This version is mostly records of checks. The one change people will see is in the public demo. It now has a second build for browsers outside the modern range, so those browsers can leave the startup screen. The modern build and the modern-only test build both stay in use.
summary_yue: 今個版本大部分都係檢查紀錄。最明顯嘅改動喺公開示範版。而家有兩個版本，超出現代瀏覽器範圍嘅瀏覽器會載入後備版本，就可以離開啟動畫面。現代瀏覽器繼續用現代版，只限現代瀏覽器嘅測試版都保留。

highlights.title: Older browsers can leave the startup screen
highlights.what: The public demo is now built for two kinds of browser. Browsers outside the modern range load a legacy bundle, which lets them move past the startup screen. Modern browsers keep using the modern build, and the modern-only test build is still kept.
highlights.what_yue: 公開示範而家分開兩種瀏覽器用嘅版本。超出現代範圍嘅瀏覽器會載入舊版套件，就可以離開啟動畫面。現代瀏覽器繼續用現代版，只限現代瀏覽器嘅測試版亦都保留。
highlights.why: Browsers outside the modern range could not leave the startup screen of the public demo.
highlights.why_yue: 超出現代範圍嘅瀏覽器以前走唔出公開示範嘅啟動畫面。
try: Open the demo and choose a browser type: modern or older.
Switch off the legacy bundle, then start the demo with the older browser type. The startup screen stays up.
Switch the legacy bundle back on and start again. The demo leaves the startup screen and shows the home view.
